cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

mechanism: A makes a former repair pupil pay in an impossible measure of time, correcting its questions as if delayed payment were a lesson in patience.
confusable: Not merely asking for repayment later: yesterday is the currency and ordinary wasted minutes supposedly mature into it.
comparison: Bargaining over access and additional fear versus making the pupil wait for payment to become valid.
seedUse: D166 kettle/spoonful yesterday/today/overnight; S05 repair fee and date checking.
